evidence_source: the record's focal form and synthesis
option_evidence: the definition given with the option

sections.heading: For each distinct specific type of {{parent_entity}} you identify, this must hold:

rules.text: This specific type qualifies on its own merits using only the immediate evidence in the record's focal form and synthesis; general evidence of {{parent_entity}} does not by itself prove any specific type of it.

sections.heading: Match each specific type you identified by the first of these rules that applies, in order:

rules.text: An option whose meaning exactly matches the identified type is chosen.

children.text: Choose by comparing the identified type against {{option_evidence}}, never by lexical or name similarity, and without forced or contrived links that rely on assumptions beyond the record. In particular, do not choose an option whose name resembles the identified type when {{option_evidence}} does not cover this case.

rules.text: When no option exactly matches, an option whose meaning generalizes the identified type while remaining more specific than {{parent_entity}} is chosen.

When no option exactly matches or generalizes the identified type while remaining more specific than {{parent_entity}}, the identified type is proposed as an option of its own, a sibling of the ones provided.

children.text: Unless the proposed option restates the meaning of an existing option under different words; in that case that existing option is chosen instead.
